description: This file defines a Java interface for managing customer option sets in a sales management system. It declares methods for saving, updating, and retrieving customer option sets based on store, option, or option value.

classes.name: CustomerOptionSetService
classes.description: A Java interface for customer option set management, extending a generic service interface for CRUD operations.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a CustomerOptionSet entity, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet objects filtered by MerchantStore and Language.

methods.name: listByOption
methods.description: Returns CustomerOptionSet objects associated with a specific CustomerOption and MerchantStore.

methods.name: listByOptionValue
methods.description: Gets CustomerOptionSet objects corresponding to a particular CustomerOptionValue within a store.
